WITH telescope_averages AS (
  SELECT t.telescregistry, t.equipstatus, AVG(s.pulsepersec) AS avg_pulse_rate
  FROM telescopes AS t
  JOIN signals AS s ON s.telescref = t.telescregistry
  WHERE s.pulsepersec IS NOT NULL
  GROUP BY t.telescregistry, t.equipstatus
), status_averages AS (
  SELECT equipstatus, AVG(avg_pulse_rate) AS avg_pulse_rate
  FROM telescope_averages
  GROUP BY equipstatus
), first_mean AS (
  SELECT AVG(avg_pulse_rate) AS mean_rate FROM status_averages
), first_kept AS (
  SELECT sa.equipstatus, sa.avg_pulse_rate, sa.avg_pulse_rate - fm.mean_rate AS excess_first
  FROM status_averages AS sa CROSS JOIN first_mean AS fm
  WHERE sa.avg_pulse_rate > fm.mean_rate
), second_mean AS (
  SELECT AVG(avg_pulse_rate) AS mean_rate FROM first_kept
), remaining AS (
  SELECT fk.avg_pulse_rate, fk.excess_first, fk.avg_pulse_rate - sm.mean_rate AS excess_second
  FROM first_kept AS fk CROSS JOIN second_mean AS sm
  WHERE fk.avg_pulse_rate > sm.mean_rate
)
SELECT AVG(avg_pulse_rate) AS avg_pulse_rate_average,
       AVG(excess_first) AS avg_excess_over_first_mean,
       AVG(excess_second) AS avg_excess_over_second_mean
FROM remaining;
